title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
premise: While their father serves in the Civil War, the four March sisters, Meg, Jo, Beth and Amy, grow up in Massachusetts with their mother, Marmee.

moments.title: Christmas breakfast
moments.happened: The girls give their Christmas breakfast to the Hummels, a poor family nearby.

moments.title: The burned manuscript
moments.happened: Angry at being left out, Amy burns the book Jo has been writing for years.
alternatives: Amy goes to the theatre with them

moments.title: Scarlet fever
moments.happened: Visiting the Hummels while Marmee is away, Beth catches scarlet fever.

moments.title: Meg chooses John Brooke
moments.happened: Meg accepts the poor tutor John Brooke despite Aunt March’s threats.

moments.title: Laurie’s proposal
moments.happened: Laurie proposes to Jo, and she tells him she can’t love him that way.
alternatives: Jo goes to Europe instead of Amy

moments.title: Beth’s last spring
moments.happened: Beth’s health fades, and the family gathers around her at home.
alternatives: Beth goes south for her health

moments.title: Under the umbrella
moments.happened: Professor Bhaer proposes to Jo under an umbrella in the rain.
alternatives: Jo becomes a famous novelist alone
